title: Ka’anapali Beach Parasail
specs: Flights up to 1,200 feet above West Maui coast
Dry takeoff and landing on boat deck, no swimming required
Views of resort strip, Black Rock, Lahaina, Lānaʻi, Molokaʻi, and West Maui Mountains
Crew speaks English, Spanish and Japanese
The minimum combined weight is 130lbs and maximum combined weight about 450-550 lbs.
Minimum age 5 years, no upper age limit
Waiver signed by parent or guardian for under 18

services.name: Parasail flights
services.desc: Our parasail season runs May 16 through December 14. We shut down for the winter - not for weather, but because thousands of humpback whales arrive in the channel. Here's how to plan around it, and what to do if you're here in the off-season. Maui Whale Adventures runs December 1 to April 1 - so the two seasons overlap by a couple of weeks. Cyan months are parasail months; gold months are whale-watching months with our sister boat. The seasons overlap: parasailing runs May 16 to December 14, whale tours December 1 to April 1. blurb: Guests fly solo, tandem, or triple on a parasail with dry takeoff and landing from a boat. Flights last 8 to 14 minutes in the air, with the whole trip about an hour including shuttle from the beach. The operation runs May 16 to December 14, with USCG-certified captains and safety equipment.

quotes.text: The crew was friendly, professional, and made us feel safe the entire time. The views of Kaʻanapali Beach were absolutely incredible.
We had an unforgettable time. The launch and landing were smooth, and the scenery was stunning.
